title: An op-amp amplifier with a gain of 10
story: A sensor gives 0.3 V but your analogue-to-digital converter works best with about 3 V. Build a non-inverting amplifier with a gain of 10: the op-amp (powered from -12 V and +12 V) has its plus input on the sensor and a 1 kOhm resistor from its minus input to ground. Choose the feedback resistor from the output to the minus input.

goals.label: the two inputs within 1 mV of each other (feedback working)

hints: The non-inverting gain is 1 + R_F / R_G.
For a gain of 10 with R_G = 1 kOhm, R_F must be about 9 kOhm.
If the gain is too large the output hits the 12 V rail; then the inputs are no longer equal.
